text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You're the culprit behind the theft, aren't you!
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Why the Boss?!
What is the meaning of this, sir?!

According to the student, the training materials
she left in the classroom had gone missing.

However, one sheet from the documents was found dropped right outside the Trainer's office.
Because of that, suspicion seems to have fallen on me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'm... going to run against Fenomeno soon.
So to prepare for that, you...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please wait!
That is simply out of the question, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The Boss is not someone who would ever steal... Never!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
But... I saw it.
Yesterday, after school—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I saw Trainer <username>
looking around while walking down the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: What were you doing back then...?
choice_data_list: I-I was just checking the locks! That's all!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: There is no mistake in this testimony! After all, it is the Boss's daily routine!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I can't just... nod along and accept that...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Is there even a culprit in the first place?
It might have simply been lost by accident."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A single sheet left in front of the trainer's office—
I will track down the missing documents using this scent.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhale*... *sniff sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Something like that happened...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Shh... The scent is fading.
Please let me concentrate.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: !! Over there!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...
It continues on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I don't really feel anything, though...
choice_data_list: I need you to believe in Fenomeno here.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This direction... I've got it.
It's behind the school building!

What we arrived at was a garbage collection point.
In other words, could the documents really be in here?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Other scents are getting mixed in.
I don't think I can track it any further.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: To begin with... is it really true that the scent lingered? None of us can tell.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Please wait here.
We will find out once I inspect the trash bag.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me.
I will prove your innocence without fail!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOAAAAHHHーーー!!!!

Fenomeno digs through the trash bags one after another.
She's moving with such incredible speed that I can't even find an opening to help out...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Aargh, is this it?! No! What about this paper?! No!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
!! This is...!
There it is, I found it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, I did it!
Case closed, sir!!
choice_data_list: You did it, Meno! Thank you...!
You did it, Meno! Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I am truly sorry for having doubted you!
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it. I'm just glad we found the documents.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It likely blew in through the window, got mistaken for trash, and was thrown away.
Unluckily, part of it ended up in front of the Trainer's Room...
choice_data_list: You believing in me is what saved me.
I was saved thanks to you believing in me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: It is only natural that I place my faith in the Boss, sir.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Checking the locks late into the evening,
without anyone ever asking her to.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even when doubted, your pure heart bears no ill will toward others.
I know very well that you are the very embodiment of justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The honor is all mine, to serve a Boss I can believe in without a shadow of a doubt!
choice_data_list: I'll keep holding onto an upright heart.
Your slick detective work was so cool!
Your clever investigation was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The honor is all mine, to serve a Boss I can believe in without a shadow of a doubt!
choice_data_list: I'll keep holding onto an upright heart.
Your slick detective work was so cool!
Your clever investigation was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes, there is no finish line on the path of justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: At times, being misunderstood and having things like today happen must leave you feeling empty.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Still, I will always be on the side of your virtuous self.
Please remember that, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I am humbled by such high praise! I merely did what was expected of me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you're in trouble,
I will rush over and solve it immediately!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
24 hours a day, anytime!
Please don't hesitate to consult me!
